items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Management emphasized the tight lithium market due to strong demand in electric vehicles and stationary storage, with supply lagging demand. The company maintained its overall 2026 outlook, expecting to perform at the high end of scenario ranges. Net income attributable to Albema

items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: ALB shares have tumbled 29.1% in the past six months. A pullback in lithium prices has weighed on the stock amid softer EV demand in China, elevated inventory and expected supply from mine restarts.

items.headline: [US Feature Stocks] Albemarle reaches tentative wage agreement with union day before Chilean strike
items.snippet: Albemarle reached a tentative wage agreement with Chilean union leadership ahead of a strike; the proposal must be ratified through a member vote.

items.headline: Albemarle's Next CEO Inherits A $250 Million Swing Per Dollar
items.snippet: Chinese EV sales fell 13% in H1 2026 after subsidy withdrawals, yet global lithium consumption jumped 45% through May; stationary storage is driving the gap.

items.headline: Market Chatter: Lithium Miners' Profits Surge as Battery Storage Demand Drives Prices Higher
items.snippet: Lithium producers from China to Australia have seen profits soar as demand from the energy storage sector pushes prices higher. Albemarle (ALB) noted that global lithium demand grew 45% through May this year, significantly outstripping supply.
